name: Sleeve housing and port windows
function: The thick-walled sub in the casing string that carries the port windows and the inner sleeve.

tabs.overview: Threaded pin and box ends like a casing joint; four windows around the middle sized for the stage rate; the inner sleeve covers them until it shifts.
tabs.engineering: Casing grade material; ports sized for erosion at rate.
tabs.safety: Ports open only when the sleeve shifts; a premature shift is a pressure-cycle event.
tabs.evidence: Completion codes article (S34), ball injector patent (S35), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
